source_review: Entire 20-file combined diff inspected, plus common codec, capture and actual producer/controller assertions and CTest registration.
Stable explicit phases/reasons/domains/known bits; zero remains known only by bit; absent fields encode zero; signed raw boundaries checked; unsupported IDs retained opaque.

Fixed 512-byte line parser and 16-event state; checked decimal overflow, every read split and byte fragmentation, malformed discard through LF, EOF finalization, bounded attempt history and omissions.
Actual startup uses shared fgetc byte-counted helper and mandatory LF, rejects NUL/CR/high bytes/oversized/incomplete prefixes, preserves first legacy hash; Windows stdin explicitly binary.
Both platform parents emit OFFER; children select offered version via HELLO before event production. Worker/attempt mismatches and malformed/duplicate HELLO/FINAL cannot certify success.

ParseCapture TLS tracks first originating controlled parser reason and genuine RapidJSON code/offset. Public independent recursive calls restore boundary; Impl dependency recursion retains current origin; valid captures clear stale result.

Actual parse and graphics/compute/raytracing/shader creation paths carry detector results independent of prose; successful compile-required fallback emits no failure; failure emits its actual signed VkResult.
Healthy timeout dispatcher emits threshold/elapsed before termination; existing timeout history keeps native delivery and status separate; no invented culprit hash.

Complete bounded event writes are serialized with ordinary-thread mutex; asynchronous signal handlers retain legacy small writes without entering that mutex. Linux startup confines newly generated SIGPIPE and preserves mask/disposition/preexisting pending signal.

Linux transport uses actual read count. Windows transport uses actual overlapped count, handles ERROR_MORE_DATA fragments and runs finish after terminal drain or error cleanup; platform-native execution is explicitly waived/unverified.

Negotiated success requires HELLO/FINAL/no loss/no unsupported/no omitted/no failure events plus independently observed native success; FINAL cannot override abnormal status. Failed attempts retain earlier events through successful retries.

Public headers and shared control block are unchanged; existing normal/master/progress/direct-slave compatibility and actual original-header callers remain registered. New private test adapters are only compiled in fixture translation units.
